endpoints: regret = mean-plan selected loss minus minimum mean-plan deletion loss

statistical_protocol.aggregation: three fixed model seed performances averaged within parent before family means
statistical_protocol.conditions: R,D,S and each condition reported separately; no pooled primary result
statistical_protocol.interval_scope: percentile95 paired family bootstrap, conditional on fitted seeds
statistical_protocol.multiplicity: Intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals; this script makes no multiplicity-adjusted superiority declaration

diagnostic/expected_loss_oracle.scope: Evaluator-only minimum after averaging the fixed independent action bank

diagnostic/future_attention_label_oracle.scope: Privileged future-query attention label argmin; not a deployable causal baseline

limits: An oracle with low expected loss is not a deployable strategy.
Full-reference sensitivity is not qualified if K3 content gates fail.
Seed-average performance is not a model ensemble and does not treat seeds or siblings as independent samples.
No empirical bound on independent scorers is inferred without the separately checked generator conditions.
